question.text: A coil of inductance <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></math> having negligible resistance is connected to a source of supply whose voltage is given by <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>V</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>t</mi></math> volt. (where <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>t</mi></math> is in second).
